scope: Portfolio and OpenCAD hub, project introductions, guides, workflow pages and development notes in this repository. External viewer application repositories are not modified.
method: Compare existing localized titles, descriptions and authored headings against Korean meaning and terminology in first-party locale documentation. This is a terminology and search-intent review, not a search-volume estimate.

locales.change: Correct the portfolio description wording and expose the free NC/G-code viewer purpose in the guide title.
Use explicit development-note and workflow titles; replace generic processing-strategy copy with machining terminology.
Correct machining-feature mistranslations, title separators, native G-code wording and furniture parts-list terminology.

terms: 免费在线 CAD 查看器
locales.change: Correct units and machining terminology, separate the CAD-viewer title from the drawing-review description, and use a consistent author name.
Restore recognition and automation in portfolio titles and use furniture-planning, machining and production-handoff terminology.

findings.issue: A live technical-note search title mistranslated machining features as machining functions (加工機能), while several complete titles lacked the author separator.
findings.resolution: Use 加工フィーチャ認識 in the relevant titles and copy and restore the author separator.

findings.issue: The NC guide headline used 单元 for measurement units; several titles and the article byline used inconsistent or duplicated author names.
findings.resolution: Use 单位 and consistent Sean Kim bylines without changing technical responsibilities.

findings.issue: The CAD collection title combined an action and a product noun redundantly: 看图与查看器.
findings.resolution: Use CAD 查看器 in the title and CAD 看图工具 in the explanatory description.

findings.issue: Some search titles described machining features or furniture but omitted recognition, automation or planning; development-note descriptions used generic processing vocabulary.
findings.resolution: Restore Feature-Erkennung, Fusion-CAM-Automatisierung and Möbelplanung; clarify Bearbeitungsstrategien and Produktionsübergabe.

findings.issue: Story-style technical-note titles and a furniture-factory compound obscured the documented technical topic.
findings.resolution: Use concise Fusion CAM, machining feature recognition and SketchUp manufacturing-data titles.

limits: First-party terminology is evidence for local wording, not proof that a keyword has the largest Google search volume.
English technical terms such as CAD/CAM and SketchUp remain where naturally used in the locale.
Existing canonical URLs and language alternates are retained; no keyword-only doorway pages or meta keywords are added.
Translation and deployment verification do not establish Google indexing or ranking gains.
